subject.title: [Bug]: All channels enter broken state after 2026.6.11 update — one message per session then permanent silence

question: Does current main or a beta package fully cover the reported v2026.6.11 all-channel one-exchange-then-silence plus duplicate-reply failure, or should this issue remain the live stable-regression tracker until a deterministic repro is captured?
rationale: The related code, issues, and PRs cover plausible slices, but the report combines cross-channel silence, duplicate replies, session-file cleanup, and stable-release packaging, so automation cannot safely declare the central failure fixed without maintainer/live proof.

options.title: Keep as canonical live tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers capture live logs or a packaged repro that either proves a remaining bug or identifies the exact fixing release.

options.title: Close after package proof
options.body: Close only if maintainers can point to a beta or stable package that reproduces and fixes the same all-channel failure mode.

options.title: Split into narrower trackers
options.body: Move any confirmed replay-storm, reply-init, or wedged-lane slice to a narrower existing issue while preserving this report as context.

recommendation.title: Keep as canonical live tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers capture live logs or a packaged repro that either proves a remaining bug or identifies the exact fixing release.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman merged the current-main reply-session fix that is most directly tied to the stable v2026.6.11 package divergence and can best judge whether it fully covers this report.
